node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 K3 orientation and owner assembly
node.statement: Every unpaid same-owner balanced-core bad-slope witness in the active KoalaBear m2 r4 first-match residual is routed exhaustively and without overlap into the source-line, coordinate, or source-cover orientation. The source-line image is exactly the declared c2(1,1,2) source-line workboard; the coordinate image is exactly the signed negative/positive coordinate workboards; every source-cover image is either proved empty, mapped bijectively to one of those two images, or paid by a printed exact distinct-affine-slope integer. The theorem outputs the disjoint source-cover sum U_sourcecover and preserves received-line owner, support reconstruction, affine slope, and chronology.
node.falsifier: A balanced-core bad slope outside the three orientations, a source-cover survivor with no exact payment, overlap between owners, or loss of received-line/slope identity under routing.
